international.title: Pip review will call for overhaul rather than scrapping benefit for under-25s
international.summary: Recommendations overseen by Stephen Timms would retain system for all ages, unlike last week’s Milburn review A long-awaited review into the personal independence payment (Pip) system will this week recommend that it is overhauled – a week after another report called for it to be partially scrapped. The final report into Pip by a committee co-led by the social security minister, Stephen Timms, is expected to come out as soon as Tuesday, presenting Andy Burnham with one of his most politically sensitive decisions as prime minister.
